name: Enter Crazy Office desktop lobby
description: Validate that desktop preview renders the original 3D lobby and gameplay HUD.
steps: Wait for Desktop Preview to enable
Inspect the 3D lobby and HP HUD
expected: The boot overlay closes, the lobby is rendered and HP and score UI are visible without a startup error.

name: Survival displays office mayhem checklist
description: New office micro-missions appear in a real combat shift.
steps: Read the yellow Office Mayhem panel
expected: The HUD shows Survival and four Office Mayhem tasks: PANIC BUTTON, OFFICE BASKETBALL, COFFEE BREAK and STAPLER SNIPER.

name: Campaign Levels starts independently
description: Campaign arena retains its boss encounters while physical hit reactions and breakable office props add feedback.
steps: Observe the boss name, warning and combat behavior
During actual VR play, hit a coworker with a bat and throw a fragile office item into furniture
expected: A themed boss spawns with a visible boss health bar. Its attack shows a warning, then triggers its map-specific effect; the weak point lights up afterward for bonus damage. In VR interaction testing, coworkers recoil and a fragile prop can shatter with visible fragments under sufficient impact.

name: Reset to hub clears shift objectives
description: Shift-only UI must disappear when the player returns to the hub.
steps: Press R to return to lobby
expected: The mode returns to the cozy lobby and the shift-only Office Mayhem panel is hidden.

name: Mobile game entry without VR headset
description: Mobile users can enter the 3D preview even without an XR headset.
steps: Open the game on a mobile browser viewport
Wait until Desktop Preview is enabled
expected: The boot panel closes and the HUD is visible; no headset connection is required for Desktop Preview.
